trailers.overview: The residents of the public housing complex are united in their refusal to accept Mr. Bahlil’s plan to demolish their complex. But they’re also having a hard time getting rid of Bunga’s ghost, who’s suddenly been haunting Room 609 to demand that Arka keep his promise! But can the residents really drive away both Mr. Bahlil’s plans and Bunga at the same time? Is it really that easy to banish a developer’s evil intentions and a real ghost? Based on Thai movie "Buppah Rahtree" (2003).

trailers.overview: Somewhere in Los Angeles, the city of broken dreams, a stripper is murdered. Now, the private detective she had hired and her ex-footballer boyfriend are going to find her murderer... if they don't kill each other first. But the more they dig, the deeper they become enmeshed in a web of extortion, blackmail and corrupt politics hidden beneath the surface of professional football.
